verdict.rationale: Appwrite explicitly supports self-hosting the entire backend via Docker (docs-14/19/33), and the CLI can target a self-hosted endpoint (docs-22) to manage projects/functions locally, with a community comment noting the containerized setup aids 'distributed dev (and testing!)' (appwrite-comm-6). However, there's no dedicated 'emulator' concept or first-party local-dev/testing workflow (like a lightweight sandbox mode) documented—only full Docker self-hosting plus CLI management. Missing for 10: a purpose-built local emulator/test harness, quickstart guide framed around local-before-deploy workflow, and independent hands-on confirmation of a smooth local dev loop.
